question: What can a consecrated and capable disciple attain by his own power?
premises: A wise disciple, strong through knowledge, yoga, and related means, can obtain enjoyment or liberation by his own power.
This can be true even if he was previously only a samaya initiate.
inference: A disciple empowered by knowledge and yoga may attain enjoyment or liberation independently, even from a prior samaya status.
uncertainties: The verse implies but does not fully explain how samaya status relates to later consecration.
plain_english: A wise disciple who is strong through knowledge, yoga, and related means can obtain either enjoyment or liberation by his own power, even if he had previously been only a samaya initiate.
